race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: There's a feeling the 3-y-os may come to the fore in this competitive opener. SOVEREIGN VIEW was tackling 1¼m for the first time when successful at Sandown in August and is narrowly preferred to Stoneacre Donny . Low-mileage pair Light of Paris and Black Chiffon are other 3-y-os with something to recommend them. Rajapour and Per Contra may prove best of the older brigade. SOVEREIGN VIEW STONEACRE DONNY LIGHT OF PARIS (GER)
